title: 摩根大通戴蒙：AI让网络风险上升十倍，关键基础设施联盟启动
speaker: Jamie Dimon

segments.en: So the banks have always had a system in place, we help each other, we also started a thing called the Alliance for Critical Infrastructure.
segments.zh: 银行一直有互助机制，我们还发起了一个叫关键基础设施联盟的组织。

segments.en: It's starting with 50 companies, it's starting in the US, it's across six industries, you know, tech, financial services, water, transport, these industries that the government point out is lifeline, but eventually it should probably expend to healthcare, farmer, agriculture.
segments.zh: 起步有50家公司，从美国开始，覆盖科技、金融服务、水务、交通等六个行业，政府视其为生命线，最终可能扩展到医疗和农业。

segments.en: I mean, every industry is kind of critical, and it should also, we need to help the smaller companies too, because they have different vendors and different needs, and so it's a lot of work, we simply have to do it.
segments.zh: 每个行业都有关键性，我们也需要帮助小公司，因为它们有不同的供应商和需求，工作很多，但必须做。

segments.en: AI created vulnerabilities that we didn't know about, and we always were about cyber before these things, and you've thought about cyber risks for a long time, yeah, I know that, it's your biggest risk, yeah, it's your biggest risk, does AI make cyber systemic risks more likely?
segments.zh: AI制造了我们不知道的脆弱性，我们一直关注网络风险，你长期思考网络风险，这是你最大的风险，AI会让网络系统性压力更可能发生吗？

segments.en: Oh, yeah, that's what I'm saying, that mythos, whatever you thought it was before, I mean, I published my chairman's, I said, I said cyber is our biggest risk, and they didn't publish mythos yet, and I would say that went up tenfold after it mythos.
segments.zh: 是的，这就是我要说的，无论你之前怎么想，我在主席信中说网络是我们最大的风险，当时还没发布相关模型，我认为之后风险上升了十倍。
